newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Dog lovers in stew over Vietnam's gastronomy.
newsitem.headline: Dog lovers in stew over Vietnam's gastronomy.

text.p: One foreign dog-lover bared her teeth at another in Vietnam on Saturday, arguing that dog remains man's best friend, whether alive or served up as a stew with a glass of wine.
"I don't known any Vietnamese, and barely any foreigners, who are unable to stomach dog," Ms Truman of Hanoi wrote in a letter to the English-language daily Vietnam News.
"I am a regular eater of dogs, delighting in its rich fragrance," she wrote. "In fact, glancing at my calendar now I count down the days till my next dog feast."

She was replying to an irate letter earlier this month from Ms Miller of Ho Chi Minh City, who took the daily to task for running an article in its restaurant review headlined: "Whatever happens to all those little puppies?"
Miller said publishing the article in an English-language paper was "akin to advocating in graphic detail the pleasures of premarital sex in a newspaper destined for Moslems."
Truman snapped back, noting that it was funny how Miller conceded that she had no right to come to Vietnam and criticise its customs and then proceed to do just that.
"But still, not enough to disturb my fondness for that lovely aromatic meat," she said.
